description: Defines a custom UI component 'HeroCard' for Android TV applications, representing a compact, focusable card with scalable focus animation and customizable title, to be used in a hero banner row.

classes.name: HeroCard
classes.description: A custom CardView component designed for a hero banner in an Android TV app, with focus scaling and customizable title.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title text displayed on the hero card.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels based on screen density.
